nanath_10.m: You? How dare you show your face?

r: I expect to be reimbursed of course.

nanath_102.m: Umar will refund you, but only if you succeed.

nanath_110.m: Have you found Luthor's ring yet?
r: I am looking for it now.
I have no idea where to look any more.

nanath_12.m: You? How dare you show your face?

nanath_120.m: Looks like it ended up being kept somewhere dangerous.

nanath_122.m: Then ... only one person may know: Fanamor's friend Sly Seraphina.
r: Sly Seraphina? Where can she be found?
On no! Not Seraphina! I refuse to talk to her.

nanath_130.m: She's the thief near the Sutdover bridge.
r: Sutdover bridge? So I'll look for her to the south.
All right, I hate to, but for the greater good I'll go.

nanath_136.m: Then it's all settled. Go and find her, now.

nanath_140.m: Then go and find her, now.

nanath_150.m: How progresses the task? I hope you've done it? We're in a pickle here, kid. No time to dawdle.
r: Dawdle! Do it yourself if you know everything better!

nanath_152.m: Calm down. I'm just nervous. Did you make any progress?

r: Seraphina has disappeared. She's scared to unleash some monsters which she says Umar and her sealed up.

nanath_170.m: She must. Go to Umar. He's the only one she'll listen to.

nanath_18.m: You betrayed the Guild over the task with Defy. Get out!

nanath_180.m: So, that's what Umar is hush-hush about.
r: He could really be more talkative sometimes.

nanath_181.m: Anyway, we must find her. I know some of her usual hidings.

nanath_181a.m: She prefers to be close to a town so she can easily stock up.

nanath_182.m: Let me think: Fallhaven would be too near. Sullengard, Stoutford, Vilegard and Prim come to my mind. And Loneford or Brimhaven, of course.

nanath_184.m: She must be found. By any means.

r: Yes. She told me I would need Luthor's key.
Yes. She told me I would need Luthor's key.

nanath_192.m: I spoke to Umar. He already suspected that you would need this key.

nanath_192a.m: Here you have it, handle it carefully.

nanath_193.m: I have given it to you already, forgotten?
r: Oh, right. I'm ashamed of myself for trying to trick you.

nanath_20.m: Hi there. I am Nanath, the oldest and most experienced man in the guild. No need to introduce yourself, I know who you are, $playername.
r: Oh. Hi Nanath. You look scared.

nanath_22.m: Well, one of our ex-clients, Lady Dameni, has put an adverse Shadow spell on us.

nanath_24.m: It makes us noticeable, and thus vulnerable to being caught - paralyzing our honest bread and butter work.

nanath_26.m: Umar wants me to handle it. He wants me to get it dispelled, so that the Thieves' Guild can work again.

nanath_272.m: Then take it to Talion. Quickly.

nanath_28.m: The thing is I don't know much about the Shadow or any other so-called powers. My life has been being an honest thief, a score here, a score there - I don't tangle with the supernatural stuff.

nanath_290.m: You were obviously successful. We seem to be inconspicuous again.

r: I can help. I've had some dealings with the Shadow.

nanath_300.m: Good job! I didn't think you could do it. But you did.
r: Yes. The search was a nice change.

nanath_302.m: Sly Seraphina has already been here and returned Luthor's key to Umar. So the room with those dangerous creatures is sealed again.

nanath_304.m: Sure. You should know her by now.

nanath_308.m: Umar asked me to reimburse you for your expenses. And something as a thank you. So here are {75000} shining pieces of gold.

r: Sorry, hush-hush stuff around Loneford and Vilegard.

nanath_40.m: First things first, how can we know the nature of the spell?

nanath_44.m: Maybe talking to a Shadow priest may help?
r: I'll see what I can do.

nanath_70.m: Oh, back again? I hope you bring good news.
r: Maybe. Talion, a Shadow priest, has put the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell on us.
I have been looking for the things for Talion.
I am still looking for Seraphina.
And ... I think I have to talk to Talion again.
Talion said he can help dispel it.

nanath_82.m: What does he want in return?
r: Lady Dameni paid him. Talion wants {50000} gold to dispel us.

nanath_84.m: That's a lot, but it was to be expected. It's good that he doesn't want more.
r: Well ... he also wants the following items: The Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, the Ring of backstabbing and the Tears of the Shadow potion.

nanath_92.m: Do you already have all of the items?
r: I don't have Troublemaker's ring yet.
I don't have the Ring of backstabbing yet.
I don't have the Villain's ring yet.
I don't have the Tears of the Shadow yet.
I have already brought the 4 easier things.

nanath_94.m: Well, then go and find it. Hurry now!

troubling_times.10: I went to the Thieves' Guild in Fallhaven looking for things to do.
troubling_times.20: Since I had helped Defy, Umar and Nanath threw me out. I cannot enter the basement again.
troubling_times.30: Since I had looted the Thieves' Guild vault after killing Defy, Umar and Nanath threw me out. I cannot enter the basement again.
troubling_times.40: I met Nanath, who's scared and upset, because someone put a spell on all members of the Thieves' Guild. This spell made all thieves noticeable. He asked me if I could help dispel the spell.
troubling_times.50: Nanath told me to find the Shadow priest who had cast the spell on the Guild.
troubling_times.60: I set out interviewing Shadow priests to find who had cast the spell.
troubling_times.70: Talion, Shadow priest of Loneford, had cast the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell on the Guild, on payment from Dameni, a mysterious lady leading a band of toughs
troubling_times.80: Talion could dispel the spell, using a few items - Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion, Luthor's ring.  He also wanted 50000 gold.
troubling_times.82: I have informed Nanath about the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell and Talion's demands.
troubling_times.90: Nanath told me Thieves' Guild would give me the 50000 gold back when I have got the spell dispelled.
troubling_times.95: Nanath asked if I had already found Luthor's ring.
troubling_times.100: I went back to Nanath as I couldn't find Luthor's ring anywhere.
troubling_times.105: He told me to seek out Fanamor's friend Sly Seraphina near the Sutdover bridge.
troubling_times.110: Seraphina didn't believe me. She told me to go away.
troubling_times.115: Nanath sent me to Umar. He should make sure Sly carries out the order.
troubling_times.120: Umar told me one of his secret passwords to convince Seraphina.
troubling_times.130: Sly Seraphina said that Luthor's ring was to be found in the cave which Crackshot tried to open. The door was sealed by Umar and Seraphina to prevent monsters in that cave from devastating Dhayavar. The sealing was done by using Luthor's items. She and Umar decided to separate them, and keep them separate.
troubling_times.140: Seraphina felt that the danger was too high to open that door. So she disappeared.
troubling_times.150: I had to find Sly Seraphina again.
troubling_times.160: Nanath told me to look for her in her usual hiding places: Near one of the towns Sullengard, Stoutford, Vilegard, Prim, Loneford, or Brimhaven.
troubling_times.170: Talion said that without the items he asked for he couldn't help. I had to find Seraphina.
troubling_times.180: After beating the tough guys protecting Seraphina, she was convinced that I was strong enough to help her beat the monsters in the cave.
troubling_times.190: Seraphina gave me back the money she had stolen from me earlier.
troubling_times.192: I have to ask Umar for Luthor's key.
troubling_times.195: Seraphina agreed to help me and told me to meet her at the locked door in the cave where Crackshot was defeated.
troubling_times.200: I met Seraphina at the cave door where Crackshot was defeated.
troubling_times.210: Seraphina could open the door with Luthor's key wearing also his gloves. She entered the cave behind the door.
troubling_times.230: Seraphina got injured attacking one of the monsters.
troubling_times.240: I have killed the monsters blocking the entrance.
troubling_times.252: I tried to poison Seraphina, but she noticed in time. At least she didn't notice that I did it on purpose.
troubling_times.255: Seraphina already started the search for the ring.
troubling_times.260: I searched the cave for Luthor's ring. I couldn't find it.
troubling_times.270: Sly Seraphina had found the ring. She gave it to me and told me to keep it safe. She disappeared again, probably back to Sutdover bridge. I had to go to Talion.
troubling_times.280: I gave 50000 gold, Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion, and Luthor's ring to Talion.
troubling_times.290: Talion used them to undo the spell.
troubling_times.300: Talion returned Luthor's ring. The other rings were broken in the process though and the Tears of the Shadow potion was used up of course.
troubling_times.302: The room with the dangerous creatures has been locked and sealed again.
troubling_times.310: Nanath gave me 75000 gold as a reward for a job well done.
troubling_times.320: Sly Seraphina was friendly to me - for now.

wanted_men.10: Off the main road, southeast of Deebo's Orchard, I've stumbled across a group of sketchy looking men with familiar voices.
wanted_men.15: The sketchy looking men with familiar voices turned out to be the Aidem thieves from Sullengard. They were hiding-out in the woods.
wanted_men.20: While speaking with Defy, I've learned the he and his men have a grudge against the Thieves' Guild and they want to "hit them where it really hurts". Whatever that means.
wanted_men.25: Defy has revealed the location of the Thieves' Guild's vault of treasure - an underground storage unit accessible from the vacant house south of Fallhaven.
wanted_men.30: Defy has asked me to convince Troublemaker to let me borrow the key long enough that I can bring it back to Defy.
wanted_men.35: Defy has agreed to pay me 20 percent of the looted Thieves' Guild treasure if I get the key from Troublemaker and hand it over to him.
wanted_men.40: Defy has instructed me to bring Troublemaker's key to him at their new hideout located west of the Sutdover River, where the rail tracks end.
wanted_men.45: I have talked my way into acquiring the Thieves' Guild's vault key from Troublemaker, but I must return it to him quickly after I am done with it.
wanted_men.50: I told Troublemaker all that I knew about Defy, his men, and the "Lost Traveler", Alaric and how they hired me to help rob the Thieves' Guild.
wanted_men.55: Troublemaker has asked me to help him trap Defy by providing Defy with a fake key. When Defy arrives at the secret vault, the Guild members will be waiting for him.
wanted_men.56:
I gave Defy the fake version of the vault key that Troublemaker gave me. In return, Defy has given me a fake version of Troublemaker's vault key and has instructed me to return it to Troublemaker.
Defy then told me to report back to the vault in order to collect my share of the gold. He has no idea that the key I gave him is a fake.
wanted_men.57: I have reported back to the vacant house and I met Rennik there. He informed me that the Thieves' Guild has apprehended all five men and that they are now in the Guild jail.
wanted_men.60: Defy has given me a fake version of Troublemaker's vault key and has instructed me to return it to Troublemaker. Then I should report back to the vault in order to collect my share of the gold.
wanted_men.65: I have given the fake Aidem key to Troublemaker as a replacement for the real vault key.
wanted_men.70: I reported back to Defy and he rewarded me with 25000 gold.
wanted_men.75: I told Defy that I was keeping the key for myself and plan to loot the Thieves' Guild's vault myself. A fight ensued.
wanted_men.76: I have killed Defy, his three henchmen and Alaric. I really should go back to Fallhaven and talk to Troublemaker again.
wanted_men.77: I've unlocked the hatch leading to the vault. It's time to head down.
wanted_men.80: I informed Troublemaker that Defy and his men are now dead.
